SEVEN LITTLE WORLDS

Printable mandalas
for curious kids.

Animals, a woodland home, and a smiling sky. Each circular design combines a clear central picture with repeating geometric shapes. These easy pages are intended for children who prefer larger coloring spaces.

The happy octopus ↗A sea friend & simple shapesThe little garden cat ↗A curious cat & petal patternsThe bright-wing butterfly ↗Broad wings & repeating circlesThe woodland cottage ↗A tiny home & leafy geometryThe smiling sky ↗Two sky friends & star shapesThe busy little bee ↗A cheerful bee & honeycomb shapesThe gentle sea turtle ↗A patterned shell & wave shapes

Which mandala should you choose?

Start with the butterfly or bee for broad, simple sections. The cottage offers windows and a little path, while the turtle adds a few smaller shell sections. Choose the drawing that interests your child rather than an exact age label.

Printing your mandala

Open a design and tap Print this mandala. Choose A4 or US Letter paper, portrait orientation, and Fit to page in your print settings. Turn off browser headers and footers. The drawing uses 90% of the available width with extra white margins, so borderless printing is unnecessary. For markers, use suitable paper and protect the table underneath.
